Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Color.Transparent,
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        gblAppColors.Error,
        gblAppColors.ApprovalClusterStates.InProgress
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    Icon.Information,
    If(
        cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
        Icon.Blocked,
        "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        Icon.Lock,
        Icon.Information
    )
)

If(
    (IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project) || IsBlank(cmp_Header.Project.Status)),
    "",
    If(
        Or(
            cmp_Header.Project.Status = "Abandoned",
            "Inactive" in cmp_Header.Project.Status
        ),
        cmp_Header.Project.Status,
        "Active"
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        gblEnvironmentName = "QA",
        gblEnvironmentName = "Prod"
    ),
    false,
    true
)

If(
    And(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project ID'),
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'),
        Or(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
        ),
        Or(
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
        ),
        Or(
            IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
            gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
        )
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height * 7,
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project Start Date'),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height * 6,
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
    ),
    // else / default height when none of the above conditions are true
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height * 5,
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height * 4,
    Or(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
    ),
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height * 3,
    lbl_ProjectRevenues_DisplayProjectBodyRightContent_Balancing_Price_VisibilityMessage_39.Height
)

Or(
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Project ID'),// General not completed
    IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'End Date'),// Milestones not completed
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Total Capacity')
    ),
    Or(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50' = 0,
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Net Yield p50')
    ),
    Or(
        IsBlank(gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name),
        gblRecordSelectedProject.'Cluster State'.Name = "Draft"
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Table(
    {
        ItemKey: "EditFinanceInput",
        ItemDisplayName: "Edit " & Switch(
            ThisItem.Order,
            1,
            "Equity",
            2,
            "Tranche",
            ThisItem.Name
        ),
        ItemIconName: "Edit",
        ItemEnabled: true
    },
    {
        ItemKey: "ActivateFinanceInput",
        ItemDisplayName: "Activate " & Switch(
            ThisItem.Order,
            1,
            "Equity",
            2,
            "Tranche",
            ThisItem.Name
        ),
        ItemIconName: "ActivateOrders",
        ItemVisible: And(
            LookUp(
                colFinancingInputInProject,
                'Financing Category'.'Financing Category' = ThisItem.'Financing Category'
            ).Status = 'Status (Financing Inputs)'.Inactive,
            ThisItem.Order in [2,5]
        ),
        ItemEnabled: RecordInfo(
            LookUp(
                colFinancingInputInProject,
                'Financing Category'.'Financing Category' = ThisItem.'Financing Category'
            ),
            RecordInfo.EditPermission
        )
    },
    {
        ItemKey: "DeactivateFinanceInput",
        ItemDisplayName: "Deactivate " & Switch(
            ThisItem.Order,
            1,
            "Equity",
            2,
            "Tranche",
            ThisItem.Name
        ),
        ItemIconName: "DeactivateOrders",
        ItemVisible: And(
            LookUp(
                colFinancingInputInProject,
                'Financing Category'.'Financing Category' = ThisItem.'Financing Category'
            ).Status = 'Status (Financing Inputs)'.Active,
            ThisItem.Order in [2,5]
        ),
        ItemEnabled: RecordInfo(
            LookUp(
                colFinancingInputInProject,
                'Financing Category'.'Financing Category' = ThisItem.'Financing Category'
            ),
            RecordInfo.EditPermission
        )
    }
)

            bankname
        )
    )}*{If(
        ThisItem.'KfW Tranche',
        " - " & ThisItem.'KfW-Tranche Value',
        ""
    )}"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    IsBlank(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
    "Input must not be blank",
    rad_EquityData_FreeEquity.Selected.Value = 'Free Equity Options'.Percentage,
    "Number from 0 to 100, with up to two decimal places",
    Not(
        And(
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value,
                0,
                If(
                    gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
                    500000000,
                    100000000
                )
            )
        )
    ),
    "Numeric value in range 0 to " & If(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
        500000000,
        100000000
    ),
    "Free Equity must not be higher than Total CAPEX."
)

If(
    rad_EquityData_FreeEquity.Selected.Value = 'Free Equity Options'.Percentage,
    Not(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value)),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsTwoDecimal(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value,
                0,
                100
            )
        )
    ),
    Not(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value)),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value,
                0,
                If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 500000000, 100000000)
            ),
            Not(Value(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value) > locTotalDevexCapexCost)
        )
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
Text(
    If(
        rad_EquityData_FreeEquity.Selected.Value = 'Free Equity Options'.Percentage,
        If(
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value)),
                fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
                fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                    txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value,
                    0,
                    100
                )
            ),
            100 - Value(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
            Blank()
        ),
        If(
            And(
                Not(IsBlank(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value)),
                fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value),
                fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                    txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value,
                    0,
                    If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 500000000, 100000000)
                )
            ),
            Coalesce(
                Max(
                    0,
                    locTotalDevexCapexCost - Value(txt_EquityData_FreeEquityEUR.Value)
                ),
                0
            ),
            locTotalDevexCapexCost
        )
    ),
    "###,###,###,##0"
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
    Choices('Base Rate Options'),
    FirstN(Choices('Base Rate Options'),3)
)

Coalesce(
    If(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
        ['Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 3M'],
        locVatFinancingStatndardValues.locIsStandardBaseRate = true,
        ['Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 3M']
    ),
    Table(
        LookUp(
            Choices('Base Rate Options'),
            Value = locSelectedFinancingInput.'Base Rate'
        )
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_VATFinancingData_VATfacilityAmount.Selected.Value = 'VAT Facility Amount Options'.Calculated,
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    rad_VATFinancingData_VATfacilityAmount.Selected.Value = 'VAT Facility Amount Options'.Calculated,
    "Preliminary - final numbers will apply after calculation of plant",
    IsBlank(txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value),"Input can not be blank",
    Not(
        And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value)),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value,
                0,
                If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 500000000, 100000000)
            )
        )
    ),
    "Numeric value must be between 0 and " & If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 500000000, 100000000)
)

If(
    rad_VATFinancingData_VATfacilityAmount.Selected.Value = 'VAT Facility Amount Options'.Calculated,
    gblAppColors.Warning,
    gblAppColors.Error
)

If(
    rad_VATFinancingData_VATfacilityAmount.Selected.Value = 'VAT Facility Amount Options'.Calculated,
    true,
    Not(
    And(
            Not(IsBlank(txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value)),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.IsInteger(txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value),
            fn_Numeric_ProjectFinanceScreen.InRange(
                txt_VATFinancingData_VATFacilityAmountEUR.Value,
                0,
                If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 500000000, 100000000)
            )
        ))
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    locSeniorDebtAction = "Activation",
    $"{If(
        locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Status = 'Status (Financing Inputs)'.Active,
        "Deactivate",
        "Activate"
    )} Trache",
    locSeniorDebtAction = "Deletion",
    "Delete Tranche"
)

With(
    {
        locTrancheName: Switch(
            locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'Tranche Status',
            'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
            "Standard Assumptions",
            'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Term Sheet',
            $"Term Sheet - *{If(
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Bank = "other-id-123",
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'Other Bank Name',
                LookUp(
                    colAssumptionBanks,
                    id = locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Bank,
                    bankname
                )
            )}*{If(
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'KfW Tranche',
                " - " & locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'KfW-Tranche Value',
                ""
            )}",
            'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Credit Agreement',
            $"Credit Agreement - *{If(
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Bank = "other-id-123",
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'Other Bank Name',
                LookUp(
                    colAssumptionBanks,
                    id = locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Bank,
                    bankname
                )
            )}*{If(
                locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'KfW Tranche',
                " - " & locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'KfW-Tranche Value',
                ""
            )}"
        )
    },
    If(
        locSeniorDebtAction = "Activation",
        $"Are you sure you want to {If(
            locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.Status = 'Status (Financing Inputs)'.Active,
            "Deactivate",
            "Activate"
        )} ""{locTrancheName}"" tranche?",
        locSeniorDebtAction = "Deletion",
        $"Are you sure you want to Delete ""{locTrancheName}"" tranche?"
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
LookUp(
    colMonthsForDuration,
    Value = Coalesce(
        locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'Tenor Duration Month',
        locSelectedStandardAssumption.'Tenor Duration Month',
        If(
            Not(IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_YY.Selected.Value)),
            0
        )
    )
)

If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value = 'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    And(
        Drp_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_YY.Selected.Value = 0,
        drp_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_MM.Selected.Value = 0
    ),
    "0 Year and 0 Months can't be selected",
    "The Tenor duration must not be shorter than the Start of repayment."
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: "0 Year and 0 Months can't be selected"

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value = 'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'% of Capex',
    "value must be in range 0 to 100 with max one decimal.",
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'Fixed Value',
    "value must be integer in range 0 to " & If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", "5,000,000,000", "1,000,000,000") & "."
)

If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'% of Capex',
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Or(
        Not(fn_Numeric_GD.IsOneDecimal(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value,
                0,
                100
            )
        ))
    ),
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'Fixed Value',
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Or(
        Not(fn_Numeric_GD.IsInteger(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value,
                0,
                If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", 5000000000, 1000000000)
            )
        ))
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    rad_SeniorDebtData_UpfrontFee.Selected.Value = 'Upfront Fee'.'Percentage of Debt',
    "value must be in range 0 to 100 with max two decimal.",
    rad_SeniorDebtData_UpfrontFee.Selected.Value = 'Upfront Fee'.Fixed,
    "value must be integer in range 0 to " & If(gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name="Poland", "5,000,000,000", "1,000,000,000") & " without decimal."
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'% of Capex',
    "value must be in range 0 to 1,000,000,000 with max one decimal.",
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'Fixed Value',
    "value must be integer in range 0 to 1,000,000,000."
)

If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'% of Capex',
    "value must be in range 0 to 1,000,000,000 with max one decimal.",
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'Fixed Value',
    "value must be integer in range 0 to 1,000,000,000."
)

If(
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'% of Capex',
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_GD.IsOneDecimal(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value,
                0,
                100
            )
        )
    ),
    rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value = 'Fixed Amount Options'.'Fixed Value',
    And(
        Not(IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(fn_Numeric_GD.IsInteger(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value)),
        Not(
            fn_Numeric_GD.InRange(
                txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value,
                0,
                1000000000
            )
        )
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
    Choices('Base Rate Options'),
    FirstN(Choices('Base Rate Options'),3)
)

Table(
    {
        Value: Switch(
            Text(
                Coalesce(
                    locSelectedSeniorDebtTranche.'Base Rate',
                    locSelectedStandardAssumption.'Base Rate'
                )
            ),
            "Euribor 1M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 1M',
            "Euribor 3M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 3M',
            "Euribor 6M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 6M',
            "Wibor 1M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 1M',
            "Wibor 3M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 3M',
            "Wibor 6M",
            'Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 6M',
            If(
                gblRecordSelectedProjectCountry.Name = "Poland",
                'Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 3M',
                'Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 3M'
            )
        )
    }
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Coalesce(
    If(
        gblRecordSelectedProject.Country.Name = "Poland",
        ['Base Rate Options'.'Wibor 3M'],
        ['Base Rate Options'.'Euribor 3M']
    )   
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Or(
        rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value = 'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
        IsBlank(Last(colStepUpBankMargins).DurationYY.Name),
        IsBlank(Last(colStepUpBankMargins).Margin),
        Not(Last(colStepUpBankMargins).Valid),
        Last(Sort(colStepUpBankMargins,Id,SortOrder.Ascending)).DurationYY.Value = drp_SeniorDebtData_Fixed_Interest_Rate_YY.Selected.Value
            /*Sum(
                locColMargin,
                DurationYY.Value
            ) = drp_SeniorDebtData_Fixed_Interest_Rate_YY.Selected.Value*/
    ),
    DisplayMode.Disabled,
    DisplayMode.Edit
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
With(
    {locColMargin: colStepUpBankMargins},
    If(
        Or(
            rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value = 'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
            IsBlank(Last(locColMargin).DurationYY.Name),
            IsBlank(Last(locColMargin).Margin),
            Not(Last(locColMargin).Valid),
            Sum(
                locColMargin,
                DurationYY.Value
            ) = drp_SeniorDebtData_Fixed_Interest_Rate_YY.Selected.Value
        ),
        DisplayMode.Disabled,
        DisplayMode.Edit
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    And(
        locFormIsDirty,
        !IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value),
        If(
            rad_SeniorDebt_Data_TrancheStatus.Selected.Value = 'Senior Debt Tranche Status '.'Standard Assumption',
            true,
            !IsBlank(cmb_SeniorDebt_Data_Bank.Selected.bankname)
        ),
        If(
            cmb_SeniorDebt_Data_Bank.Selected.bankname = "Other",
            !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_BankName.Value),
            true
        ),
        If(
            tgl_SeniorDebt_Data_KfW_Tranche.Checked,
            !IsBlank(drp_SeniorDebt_Data_KfW_Tranche_Value.Selected.loantenor_repayfreeperiod_ratefixing),
            true
        ),
        //!IsBlank(cmb_SeniorDebt_Data_Bank.Selected.id),
        !IsBlank(dte_SeniorDebt_Data_Financial_Close.SelectedDate),
        !IsBlank(drp_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_MM.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_YY.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Data_Drawdown.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Data_EnergyYield.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Data_SpotCurve.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebtData_Gearing.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Fixed_Amount_Options.Selected.Value),
        If(
            rad_SeniorDebtData_Gearing.Selected.Value = 'Gearing Options'.'Fixed Amount',
            !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue.Value),
            true
        ),
        !IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebt_Data_RepaymentProfile.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_StartRepayment_MM.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_StartRepayment_YY.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(drp_SeniorDebt_Data_Frequency_Of_Repayment.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_Hedging.Value),
        //!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebtData_UpfrontFee.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_UpfrontFeeValue.Value),
        //!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebtData_CommitmentFee.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_Commitment_Fee_Value.Value),
        //!IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_Commitment_Fee_Free_Period_MM.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(Drp_SeniorDebtData_Commitment_Fee_Free_Period_YY.Selected.Value),
//!IsBlank(rad_SeniorDebtData_BaseRate_2.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_SwapMargin.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin_ConstructionPhase.Value),
        !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin_OperationalPhase.Value),
        !IsBlank(drp_SeniorDebtData_Fixed_Interest_Rate_MM.Selected.Value),
        !IsBlank(drp_SeniorDebtData_Fixed_Interest_Rate_YY.Selected.Value),
        If(
            tgl_SeniorDebt_Data_Swap_After_Fixed_Period.Checked,
            And(
                !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin.Value),
                !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_SwapRate.Value)
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            rad_SeniorDebtData_Gearing.Selected.Value = 'Gearing Options'.'Debt Sizing',
            And(
                !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebt_Data_DSCR_Contracted.Value),
                !IsBlank(txt_SeniorDebtData_DSCR_Uncontracted.Value)
            ),
            true
        ),
        If(
            rad_SeniorDebt_Data_RepaymentProfile.Selected.Value = 'Repayment Profile'.Individual,
            CountIf(
                colRepaymentProfileAmount,
                Valid = false
            ) = 0,
            true
        ),
        If(
            tgl_SeniorDebtData_Step_Up_Bank_Margin.Checked,
            CountIf(
                colStepUpBankMargins,
                Valid = false
            ) = 0,
            true
        ),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_SUB_ErrorMessage_1.Visible),
        // Now Error Visibility Check
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_TrancheStatus_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_Tenor_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_DSCR_Uncontracted_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_DSCR_Contracted_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        If(
            rad_SeniorDebtData_Gearing.Selected.Value = 'Gearing Options'.'Fixed Amount',
            Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_FixedAmountValue_ErrorMessage.Visible),
            true
        ),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_StartRepayment_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_Hedging_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_UpfrontFeeValue_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_CommitmentFeeValue_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_SwapMargin_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin_ConstructionPhase_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin_OperationalPhase_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_FIR_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_BankMargin_BankMargin_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(lbl_SeniorDebtData_SwapRate_ErrorMessage.Visible),
        Not(locIsSavingSeniorDebtTranche)
    ),
    DisplayMode.Edit,
    DisplayMode.Disabled
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateContext(
    {
        locSelectedDSRA_DSRF_IsStandard: {
            locIsStandardBaseRate: true,
            locIsStandardMargin: true,
            locIsStandardCommitmentFee: true,
            locIsStandardCommitmentFeeFreeDuration: true,
            locIsStandardUpfrontfee: true,
            locIsStandardPercentageoffuturedebtservice: true,
            locIsStandardDurationoffuturedebtservice: true,
            locIsStandardEndofDebtserviceSavings: true,
            locIsStandardType: true
        },
        locStandardDSRA_DSRF_For_Edit: locStandardDSRA_DSRF,
        locSelectedEndoffuturedebtservicesavings: DateAdd(
            DateAdd(
                gblRecordSelectedProject.'Operations start date (COD)',
                With(
                    {
                        lclTenorDuration: Filter(
                            colFinancingInputInProject,
                            'Financing Category'.'Financing Category' = LookUp(
                                colFinanceCategoriesInProject,
                                Order = 3,
                                'Financing Category'
                            ),
                            Status <> 'Status (Financing Inputs)'.Inactive
                        )
                    },
                    Max(
                        lclTenorDuration,
                        ('Tenor Duration Year' * 12) + 'Tenor Duration Month'
                    )
                ),
                TimeUnit.Months
            ),
            -1,
            TimeUnit.Days
        )
    }
);
Concurrent(
  //  Reset(rad_DSRA_DRSFData_DSRA_DRSF_Type),
    Reset(cmb_DSRA_DRSFData_Duration_of_furture_debt_service_YY),
    Reset(cmb_DSRA_DRSFData_Duration_of_furture_debt_service_MM),
    Reset(dte_DSRA_DRSFData_End_of_debt_service_savings),
    Reset(txt_DSRA_DRSFData_POFDS_Fee_Percentage),
    Reset(txt_DSRA_DRSFData_Upfront_Fee_Percentage),
    Reset(txt_DSRA_DRSFData_Margin),
    Reset(drp_DSRA_DRSFData_Base_Rate),
    Reset(cmb_DSRA_DRSFData_commitment_fee_free_period_YY),
    Reset(cmb_DSRA_DRSFData_commitment_fee_free_period_MM),
    Reset(txt_DSRA_DRSFData_Commitment_Fee_Percentage)
)
